notes:
Lead profile: early-stage fintech (payments + transactional insights), ~120 employees, headquartered in Boston.

Inbound path: self-serve signup -> used free credits for embeddings + chat. CTO Maya Rao leading infra decisions; product lead Elena Park handling integration. They are 'VPC-curious' but want to start on Hosted API to move fast — clear PLG play.

Security asks (early but firm): SOC2 docs, SSO/SAML + IdP metadata flow, audit logs retention policy, KMS integration for key management, ability to set retention for PII. Legal asked: "Can we get a SOC2 snapshot and sample contract clause for data retention?"

Workload profile / requirements (from SE call):
- Primary: support bot for merchants (chat) + transaction summarization on demand.
- Secondary: embeddings for doc search and reranking of suspicious transactions.
- Avg tokens / chat request: 80-150 tokens; embeddings per batch ~10-20 vectors.
- Throughput: 20-40 requests/sec burst; baseline 5-10 req/sec.
- Latency target: p95 generation <= 250ms (soft) for chat; willing to tolerate 400ms if cost savings significant.
- Cost sensitivity: high. They plan to optimize quantized open models later but want hosted reliability now.

Model preferences: prefer open/model variants (Llama2-style, Mistral family) or Redwood-curated lite models. Interested in quantization recommendations from Optimize.

Routing / resilience: need basic fallback to smaller model for peak hours. Interested in prefix/KV caching for repeated merchant prompts.

POC asks:
- 60-minute technical POC to evaluate embeddings quality on internal dataset (fraud patterns), and stub chat flow latency with sample production traffic.
- Provide SOC2 one-pager, SSO integration steps, and short security FAQ.

Quotes / verbatim: "We don't want to manage infra yet — hosted for speed, but legal will ask about SOC2 early. If that checks out, we could sign up quickly." — Maya Rao, CTO.

Next steps (AE): Send SOC2 one-pager + SSO quickstart (by 2026-03-05); book POC week of 2026-03-15; get token/month estimate from product team (by 2026-03-10).

Notes about blockers: legal wants SOC2 sample before billing sign-off; product needs to confirm burst profile (30k tokens/day?). SE to prepare cost estimate with Optimize suggestions (batching + caching).
